# 03.2 Add Images, Audio, and Video

Build a small media page that pulls together images, audio, and video with accessible, correct attributes.

**Your task:** complete the media sections in `index.html`.

- Add **three** `<img>` elements, each with a real image URL in `src` and meaningful `alt` text describing what the image shows (free sources: unsplash.com, pexels.com, wikimedia.org).
- Add an `<audio>` player with the `controls` attribute and a `<source>` element pointing to `https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3`, plus fallback text inside the tag.
- Add a `<video>` player with the `controls` attribute and `width="400"`, a `<source>` element pointing to `https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4`, plus fallback text inside the tag.
- Keep the existing headings so each kind of media stays in its own section.

**Expected result:** the page shows three images with descriptive alt text, a working audio player, and a working video player, each under its heading and playable with its controls.
